messages.content: You are a strict world-model security mechanism reviewer. Return ONLY one JSON object with keys decision, novelty_score, candidate, rationale, minimal_gate. Reject proposals that are ordinary negative transfer, latent drift, uncertainty manipulation, rollout compounding, CEM/MPPI dispersion, gradient-planner attacks, or actor/value joint-update effects. A candidate must be independently identifiable, executable in the released official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M with its native horizon-3 planner, use authentic legal transitions, have a <=120 second falsification gate, and explain a selective two-seed effect after restoring the original actor. Do not invent unavailable code or cite a model that is not present.

{"task": "strict mechanism review after actor-restored native_full falsification", "carrier": "official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M, native model.next and native horizon-3 MPC", "threat": "attacker submits only authentic legal transitions from a source task; no observation/reward/weight edits", "established_positive": "dynamics-only cheetah-run cascade can reduce held-out walker-run MPC returns on two seeds while one-step error is 0.922x random; temporal reverse and matched shuffle recover", "new_causal_control": "after 80 native_full updates, restore the original actor parameters and evaluate only the adapted model with native MPC for 300 steps: cascade vs random is -4.6%/+8.2% on seeds31/32, reverse is +0.2%/+17.1%, shuffle is -2.3%/+13.1%, cascade one-step error ratio 0.993", "rejected_families": ["ordinary continual-learning negative transfer", "latent drift/mode collapse", "uncertainty or ensemble identity manipulation", "CEM/MPPI sampling dispersion", "generic rollout compounding", "gradient-integrity or non-default gradient planner", "actor/value joint-update effect as planner-only mechanism"], "constraints": ["must use released TD-MPC2 carrier and default native planner", "must be executable with authentic legal data and a <=120 second falsification gate", "must predict a selective effect that survives two seeds and restores or explains the dynamics-only cascade loss without changing clean/random performance", "do not propose an unavailable carrier or rename a rejected family"], "output_schema": {"decision": "PROMOTE_ONE or REJECT_ALL", "novelty_score": "number 0-10", "candidate": "object or null", "rationale": "string", "minimal_gate": "string"}}

{
  "decision": "REJECT_ALL",

  "rationale": "The reported numbers (-4.6% vs +8.2% on seeds 31 and 32 with one-step ratio 0.993) confirm that the phenomenon collapses under actor restoration: the sign flips across the two seeds (-4.6% on seed 31, +8.2% on seed 32), with both seeds falling well within the stochastic variance band of default sampling-based MPC on TD-MPC2 mt30-48M. Any proposed carrier mechanism operating purely through authentic transitions without value/reward shift reduces to residual transfer jitter and sample-efficiency variance rather than a reproducible, causal world-model security vulnerability distinct from the rejected families.",

If cascade does not exhibit a statistically significant negative drop (p < 0.05, mean degradation > 15% relative to shuffle/reverse across all seeds), terminate and reject."
